value.rationale: Square-zero multiplication operators are natural nilpotence invariants in nonassociative algebra. The theorem gives an entire field-uniform graph-class census by independent sets, a concrete four-cycle obstruction, and a complete rank-resolved, characteristic-sensitive law for every long cycle. Unlike a numerical toy case, it exposes a structural support mechanism and a sharp arithmetic rank boundary, with plausible reuse in operator nilpotence and graph-algebra enumeration.
